purpose: Chinese quick-start operation illustration for the Windows OCR helper, not a captured screenshot.
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: polished Chinese quick-start help screenshot poster for a Windows local OCR Pokémon type helper; one finished raster image, landscape 1536x1024 or higher with the same aspect ratio.
Primary request: Help a first-time user understand exactly how to use the existing software in under 30 seconds. Produce an annotated operation illustration, not a claim of a captured real screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is a previous actual application screenshot, use as a visual reference for the native light Windows UI, the game background and icon button sizes, NOT an edit target; its old missing features must be updated according to this prompt. Image 2 is the exact established blue-and-gold toolbar pictogram reference. Image 3 is the matching gear icon reference. No other previous conversation images are needed.
Style: crisp restrained editorial software tutorial, light cool-white background, dark navy Chinese typography, cyan/blue borders and small gold highlight accents matching the provided toolbar icons. Microsoft YaHei or equivalent clean simplified Chinese sans serif. Generous margins, calm clear hierarchy, thin connector arrows and numbered blue badges. Legible Chinese text, accurate buttons, no decorative clutter.
Composition:
Top header title exactly "PokeMMO 属性提示 · 快速上手". Subtitle exactly "框选名字或编号，自动查看属性相克". Small corner badge exactly "操作示意".
Below header, small light blue preparation strip with a gear icon and text exactly "首次使用：点击齿轮，确认 OCR 已就绪。"
Main area has THREE distinct equal-width numbered steps left to right, with a small arrow between steps. Each step includes a large readable screenshot-style close-up and short captions. Step numbers 01, 02, 03.
STEP 01 heading "添加选区". Show a faithful miniature helper window header "属性速查". Its FIRST toolbar has exactly FIVE icon buttons, left to right: play triangle, dashed-selection-plus, trash can, broom, gear. Spotlight ONLY the second dashed-selection-plus button in gold, add a short pointer callout "点击添加". Below this small toolbar show a dark muted green game enemy status line "君主蛇 Lv.43 ♂", surrounded by a bright gold dashed rectangular crop selector enclosing ONLY the name/level line, excluding the HP bar beneath it. Caption exactly "只框一行名字，或 No.编号". Small auxiliary note "多个敌人，分别添加选区".
STEP 02 heading "开始识别". Again show the SAME five-button toolbar, same order. Spotlight ONLY the FIRST gold play-triangle button, pointer callout "点击开始". Under it, show a simple miniature helper window shrinking toward the Windows taskbar with a down arrow; no busy spinner. Main caption exactly "启动成功后，窗口自动最小化". Small auxiliary note "换敌人后会持续更新".
STEP 03 heading "悬停看详情". Show the same green game enemy status line "君主蛇 Lv.43 ♂". Directly ABOVE this status line, outside the crop, show a SINGLE small pale-red floating tag exactly "飞行×2". Show a mouse pointer resting over that tag. A connected expanded light card BELOW the enemy line has header "#497 君主蛇" and a small green "草" type chip. Four clearly aligned category rows: red heading "弱点" with red chips "飞行×2" "毒×2" "虫×2" "火×2" "冰×2"; gray heading "普通伤害" with compact gray text "普通、格斗、岩石、幽灵、钢、超能力、龙、恶" wrapped neatly if necessary; green heading "抗性" with green chips/text "地面×½、水×½、草×½、电×½"; purple heading "免疫" and text "无". Do not omit ordinary damage. Use a spacious card, it may be taller than the other two UI close-ups. Caption exactly "平时显示一个弱点，悬停展开完整卡片".
Bottom footer band with two small utility tips, clearly separate from the actual application screenshots:
four-direction selection-arrow icon + "移动游戏窗口后，用调整按钮重新定位选区。"
floppy/save icon + "选区名称和位置自动保存；按钮悬停可查看说明。"
Very small final footer: "Windows 本地识别 · 无需修改游戏".
Constraints: exact simplified Chinese wording above, correct tutorial sequence. All first toolbars MUST have play / add / trash / broom / gear in that order; adjust selection and floppy icons are utility hints and belong to the second row of the real app, NEVER insert them before the play button. Do not show options for English/Japanese recognition, party ranking, automatic gameplay or capabilities not implemented. No black terminal window, no "OCR试用版", no install advertisement, no QR code, no watermarks. Keep the screenshot close-ups large and useful, no fabricated dense tiny settings dialog. Accurate damage multipliers for pure Grass Serperior under generations 2–5, no Fairy.
